# Base Profile: donor.trace-reconstruct

<!-- NOTE (example-only): Document may show ownership tokens or identifiers for tracing examples. They are illustrative; not runtime secrets. See PROTECTED_TOKENS_ALLOWLIST.md for accepted tokens. -->

## Always Load

- `bthwani-workspace-boundaries`
- `bthwani-donor-escalation`
- `bthwani-donor-decomposition`

## Use When

- donor sources must be searched or compared
- donor evidence is needed because target evidence is weak
- a donor-driven slice must be decomposed and rebuilt cleanly

## Primary Contract

- escalate source search intentionally
- compare candidates
- return to target fit
- decompose the chosen donor candidate
- centralize reusable truth before reconstruction
- rebuild cleanly

## Typical Overlays

- `overlay.design-review` when donor beauty or visual quality is under review
- `overlay.ux-flow-review` when donor journey quality is under review
- `overlay.user-review-gates` when donor decomposition crosses visual direction approval boundaries
- `overlay.violation-audit` when donor residue or carryover risk must be inventoried
- `bthwani-central-ui-kit-compliance` when reusable truth is likely to be promoted
